en: A black‑and‑white panoramic cityscape showing the rooftops and buildings of an older European town. In the foreground are dense, low-rise houses and a distinctive round pavilion-like building with a many-sided roof and arched windows. In the distance stand taller masonry buildings and church spires under a cloudy sky. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, with additional handwritten text over the light foreground.
